leadText: Prime Video, also marketed as Amazon Prime Video, is a subscription service and digital media store owned and operated by . Originally launched on September 7, 2006 as Amazon Unbox in the , then Amazon Instant Video on February 22, 2011 , followed by Amazon Video from September 2015 and finally Prime Video in 2018. Some content is offered for free to customers with either an or dedicated Prime Video subscription; other content is available for rental or purchase.
plainText:
Prime Video, also marketed as Amazon Prime Video, is a subscription service and digital media store owned and operated by . Originally launched on September 7, 2006 as Amazon Unbox in the , then Amazon Instant Video on February 22, 2011 , followed by Amazon Video from September 2015 and finally Prime Video in 2018. Some content is offered for free to customers with either an or dedicated Prime Video subscription; other content is available for rental or purchase.
